## PM triage — `pm:blocked` on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#7159 landing

File collision: `packages/data-objectstack/` is being edited by PR objectui#7159 (objectui#6889) right now, and this finding sits on the same batch write-warning path that PR touched. Unblocks automatically.

### Why it was right to file rather than fold

PR objectui#7159 already carried **one** bounded in-place fix on this path — the batch path computing the object name twice, so a non-string wire `object` could put two different values on one warning. That one was folded in because it is the *same defect class as the card* (a value the gate does not establish reaching a consumer) and sat in the same function.

This is a different class: the object name resolving to an **empty string** when the response's index matches no operation. A value that satisfies the spec's required `object: string` while naming no object at all. Pre-existing, no reader harmed today, and folding a second unrelated repair in would have turned a bounded fix into an unbounded one — which is exactly what objectui#6889's own card warned against inheriting from PR objectui#6884.

### For whoever takes it

The card is graded p3-ish on its face: no reader is harmed today. ⛔ But do not treat "no reader harmed" as "no defect" — objectui#6889 just demonstrated that the *severity* of a boundary over-claim and the *cost of its honest repair* are not correlated. Measure the consumer end before choosing a branch, and check whether the honest fix crosses a published surface before assuming the cheap one is cheap.

⚠️ And note the neighbouring precedent now on `main`: the gate on this path was renamed `isWireDroppedFieldsEntry` and **shared** by the single-record and batch paths (it had been spelled twice). If this repair needs a similar predicate, extend the shared one rather than spelling a third.

## 🔒 Claimed — `domain:ui` seat

- **Session**: `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`
- **Branch**: `claude/issue-7160-batch-warning-empty-object`
- **Seat post**: objectstack-ai/objectui#5560

**Unblocked**: PR objectstack-ai/objectui#7159 landed as `f75810e7c` — verified on `main`, `isWireDroppedFieldsEntry` 0 → 4 with the `DroppedFieldsNotice` control alive at both shas (10 → 12). `packages/data-objectstack/` is free.

### Carried into the dispatch from the card it was split out of

⚠️ **Do not read "no reader is harmed today" as "no defect."** objectui#6889 established, by measurement, that the *severity* of a boundary over-claim and the *cost of its honest repair* are **not correlated** — the branch I predicted would be cheap was the one crossing Clause ②. Measure the consumer end before choosing a branch, and check whether the honest fix crosses a published surface before assuming the cheap one is cheap.

⚠️ **A shared predicate now exists on this path.** objectui#6889 renamed the gate `isWireDroppedFieldsEntry` and made the single-record and batch paths **share** it — it had been spelled twice. If this repair needs a predicate, ⛔ extend the shared one; do not spell a third.

⚠️ And the neighbouring precedent for the answer's *shape*: objectui#6889's repair is deliberately asymmetric with objectui#6884's `reason` arm, and says so in the code — a `reason` from the future is expected version skew, whereas an off-spec `fields` element is input to refuse here and fix at the producer. Work out which side of that line an empty `object` string falls on before writing anything.

## ✅ LANDED — PR #7176 squash-merged to `main` (`899730e0a`)

Verified **by content with a live control**:

| probe | result |
|---|---|
| SUBJECT — `UNATTRIBUTED_STRIP_OBJECT` in `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` | **4** |
| SUBJECT — same, in the new `droppedFieldsUnattributed.boundary.test.ts` | **1** |
| CONTROL — `isWireDroppedFieldsEntry` (landed by #6889) still live in `index.ts` | **4** |

## The disposition was REFUSE / TOLERATE / **DECLARE** — and the third option was the right one

The card offered two dispositions; the answer was neither, and that is the right kind of falsification — not "the premise is wrong" but "the option set was incomplete." **There is no producer value to keep or drop.** The response supplied nothing; the only question is what *we* write.

- **Refuse was measured and rejected**, not waved off: dropping the entry trades a truthful, user-visible warning for #3484's silence. The gating measurement drove the whole chain — `batchTransaction` → `onWriteWarning` → `emitWriteWarning` with the **real** `t` and the **real** `fieldLabel` — and showed the user still reads the complete toast with fields named by api key, `getObjectSchema` never called (call list `[]`), against a live control at index 1 resolving `invoice` / `update` / `Localized Tax rate`. `index: -1`, `1.5`, `0.5` and `NaN` all behave as `99`.
- **Widen was rejected on principle rather than cost** — the part most worth endorsing. Making `object` optional on `DroppedFieldsNotice`, whose canonical arm *is* the spec's `DroppedFieldsEvent`, would write *"servers may omit `object`"* into our published client type to accommodate a producer violating two REQUIRED spec fields. That is the lenient consumer-side fallback AGENTS.md #0.1 bans, and it costs the canonical arm its identity as THE spec type, which #3160 fought for. ⭐ It would *also* have crossed Clause ② and been unlandable at today's tier — but the report reaches the right answer without leaning on that, which is the stronger position.
- **Falsiness is load-bearing and is now documented**: `writeWarningToast` gates on `adapter && ev.resource`, so a namespaced sentinel would be truthful but *truthy* and would send the sole consumer to `getObjectSchema` on a non-object. Exactly the constraint a future "cleanup" breaks silently — which is why declaring it beats leaving a bare `''`.

## ⭐ The control worth singling out — proving a byte-identical diff

Establishing that `dist/index.d.ts` is **byte-identical** at base and head is how this PR proves it never entered `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The difficulty is that a byte-identical comparison has **no natural positive control** — the usual "the full files DO differ while the declaration lines do not" reassurance is unavailable precisely when the answer is "identical", which is when you most need to know the instrument works.

So one was built: append a temporary exported const (marker 0 → 1, blob `737d2dc` → `f0da4b0`), observe a 6-line full-file and 5-line declaration-line diff, then remove it and rebuild back to the head hash. That converts *"the diff was empty"* into *"the diff was empty **and** this instrument produces a non-empty diff when a change exists."*

The same discipline shows up twice more: *"the first attempt printed EMPTY marker counts from broken shell quoting and was discarded as void rather than read as zero."* ⚠️ Discarding a void reading instead of scoring it is the whole method — and it is the same failure I hit on this very landing check an hour later, when a pack control pointed at a barrel file returned empty and had to be re-pointed before its zeros meant anything.

## Ruling on the open question: **A — leave as landed**

*Does any deployed backend return a batch `droppedFields` entry that omits `object` and carries an index naming no operation?* **NOT MEASURED**, and correctly reported as such rather than guessed. **A** stands: **B** is Clause ② and unavailable at today's tier regardless of merit; **C** deletes a warning measurement shows is fully truthful. A expands no published surface and closes the actual hazard — which was never the empty string, but that it was **undeclared**.

⚠️ **The implementer's warning, carried verbatim because it is the part most likely to be lost:**

> *"Do not let a later triage pass infer the population from server code that is not in these repos."*

The placeholder is unreachable from a **conformant** response, but — unlike #6889's case — it is **not structurally impossible**, because the payload arrives as parsed JSON. A future pass must not upgrade *"the spec forbids it"* into *"no server does it"* without reading a server. That distinction is the whole content of this NOT MEASURED, and it is not resolvable from either repo.

## Also correct

- **The shared predicate was not extended, and the report explains why that is right** rather than treating non-reuse as a gap: `isWireDroppedFieldsEntry` answers *"is this a wire entry at all"*, and this entry is well-formed — the defect is a **resolution** step downstream of the gate. Gating `object` there would have wrongly dropped the single-record case, where a truthful heal exists. **No third predicate was spelled**, which is the outcome #6889 was landed to protect.
- **Behaviour neutrality proven the right way round**: the new suite passes 8/8 against the *pre-change* source (base blob `1b93160c80`, marker count 0 confirming the swap landed). The pin records existing behaviour instead of blessing new behaviour.
- **#7170 filed, not folded** — the same trigger fabricates `operation: 'create'` (measured; control reports `'update'`), and the comment above that line asserts the opposite. `WriteWarningEvent.operation` is a REQUIRED published union, so no correct fallback exists. Pinning the current value beside the control means any future disposition arrives as a visible diff. **#7170 remains open.**
- `check:readme-exports` correctly reported **NOT MEASURED** — its own verdict was *"the population COLLAPSED — this run proves nothing"*, with 353 complaints and **0** naming `data-objectstack`. Not green, not red.

Clearing `pm:dispatched`.
